verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own docs have a Terraform section for provisioning VMs and other Azure infrastructure, plus first-party tooling to export existing resources to HCL and generate Terraform configurations. That shows vendor-backed Terraform support. The evidence never names the provider, never shows who maintains it, and never mentions OpenTofu. One community comment says Microsoft is slow to update the required Terraform version, which hints at lagging maintenance. missing for 10: explicit vendor-maintained provider identity, release cadence/active-release evidence, documented core-service coverage, OpenTofu compatibility, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the official Terraform/OpenTofu provider is real — vendor-maintained, actively released, covering the core services I run
